Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked. 
 That is the whole job.
 Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.
 So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.
 At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.
 You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.
 Here is what "end to end" actually means.
 You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.
 You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.
 You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.
 You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.
 If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.
 If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.
 What the job looks like 
 Own a set of DTC accounts  as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.
 Own the client relationship.  There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.
 Audit before you touch anything.  Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.
 Run brand and non brand as different businesses.  Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.
 Know what PMax is actually doing.  The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.
 Keep Google's automation on a leash.  Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.
 Own the feed.  Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.
 Own the tracking.  GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.
 Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it.  Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.
 Build the things the account needs.  Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.
 You are a fit if 
 You have done this with real money.  Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.
 You are fluent in the whole stack , not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.
 You are AI native, and you build.  This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.
 You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level.  You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.
 You are skeptical of your own numbers.  You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.
 You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls.  Where you live is up to you.
 Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.
 You are not a fit if 
 "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.
 You want to be told what to do this week.
 You need a ticketing system to know what matters.
 You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.
 Why this role is exciting 
 This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.
 You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.
 You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.
 You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

We are looking for experienced Senior Autonomous Vehicle Technicians to support the maintenance, diagnostics, repair, and operational readiness of autonomous vehicle fleets and robotaxi operations across North America.
As a Senior Autonomous Vehicle Technician, you will be responsible for ensuring that electric and autonomous vehicles remain safe, reliable, and ready for daily deployment. This role supports autonomous ride-hailing services, robotaxi fleet operations, on-road testing programs, and new city launches where vehicle uptime, technical precision, and safety compliance are critical.
You will work closely with AV Operations Leads, Depot Specialists, Safety Operators, SDS Specialists, engineering teams, and fleet operations teams to minimize vehicle downtime and keep the fleet operational. The role combines hands-on automotive repair, EV diagnostics, high-voltage safety, software updates, and support for autonomous driving hardware.
This position is ideal for an experienced automotive technician who wants to move into the future of mobility and work directly with electric vehicles, autonomous driving systems, ADAS technology, robotics, and self-driving vehicle platforms.

Key Responsibilities: Autonomous Vehicle Maintenance 
 Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on electric and autonomous vehicles used in robotaxi fleet operations .
 Ensure vehicles are technically ready for daily deployment, testing, commercial operations, and autonomous ride-hailing services .
 Conduct detailed vehicle inspections to support fleet readiness , vehicle uptime, and operational safety.
 Diagnose and repair mechanical, electrical, electronic, and software-related vehicle issues.
 Support maintenance workflows for high-availability autonomous vehicle fleets operating in shift-based or 24/7 environments.
 Advanced Diagnostics & Repair 
 Perform advanced diagnostics on EV platforms, ADAS systems, autonomous driving hardware, and vehicle electronic systems.
 Use OEM diagnostic tools, service software, and technical procedures to identify root causes of vehicle faults.
 Troubleshoot issues related to battery systems, drivetrains, braking systems, steering systems, sensors, cameras, wiring, and vehicle control modules.
 Replace, repair, and validate vehicle components according to safety, quality, and technical standards.
 Escalate complex technical issues to engineering teams with clear documentation and diagnostic findings.
 EV & High-Voltage Systems 
 Work safely with electric vehicle systems , including high-voltage batteries, charging systems, inverters, and electric drivetrains.
 Follow strict high-voltage safety procedures when performing diagnostics, repairs, and component replacements.
 Support charging readiness and EV fleet availability in coordination with depot operations.
 Identify risks related to EV systems and escalate safety concerns immediately.
 Autonomous Driving Hardware Support 
 Support installation, inspection, and replacement of autonomous vehicle hardware components.
 Assist with checks related to cameras, LiDAR, radar, compute units, wiring harnesses, sensor mounts, and related vehicle systems.
 Coordinate with SDS Specialists when issues involve the self-driving system , sensor calibration, or autonomous driving software.
 Ensure autonomous driving hardware remains properly installed, clean, functional, and ready for operation.
 Software Updates & Technical Validation 
 Perform vehicle software updates, configuration changes, and validation checks according to defined procedures.
 Support post-repair testing to confirm vehicle functionality before returning the vehicle to robotaxi operations .
 Verify that repairs and maintenance actions do not impact vehicle safety, operational readiness, or autonomous system performance.
 Maintain accurate service records, diagnostic reports, and repair documentation.
 Shift Leadership & Team Support 
 Act as the technical lead during assigned shifts when required.
 Provide guidance and escalation support to junior technicians, depot teams, and fleet operations staff.
 Support training of new technicians on vehicle maintenance procedures, safety standards, and operational workflows.
 Collaborate with Operations Leads to prioritize vehicle repairs and reduce fleet downtime.
 Operational Excellence

 Support continuous improvement initiatives related to fleet maintenance , depot operations , and autonomous vehicle deployment .
 Maintain a clean, organized, and safe technical workspace within the depot.
 Ensure all work is completed according to safety procedures, quality standards, and customer requirements.

 Good understanding of electrical and electronic vehicle systems.
 Experience using diagnostic tools, service software, and technical repair documentation.
 Ability to follow strict technical procedures and safety protocols.
 Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
 Ability to work independently under pressure in a fast-paced operational environment.
 Comfortable working in shift-based operations, including evenings, weekends, or 24/7 fleet environments when required.
 Upper-Intermediate English.

 High-voltage certification or EV safety training.
 Experience with ADAS, autonomous vehicles, robotics, or advanced automotive systems.
 OEM certification or dealership experience with EV or premium vehicle platforms.
 Experience supporting fleet maintenance, ride-hailing fleets, mobility services, or commercial vehicle operations.

At TC Energy, we are proud to connect the world to the energy it needs. Guided by our values of safety in every step, personal accountability, one team and active learning , we deliver the critical energy that North America and the world rely on while balancing reliability, affordability and sustainability.
 Join us. Connect to what matters.
 The Opportunity 
 Our Strategy & Business Planning team is seeking a Business Analyst to support the commercial and strategic analysis of natural gas demand across the North American power sector, a critical and growing source of natural gas demand and an increasingly important driver of long-term market opportunities.
 Reporting to the Manager, Gas Market Analysis, this role will serve as a key analytical resource focused on understanding the intersection of natural gas and power markets. The successful candidate will evaluate natural gas market fundamentals, power generation fuel requirements, emerging market opportunities, and asset performance, leveraging market intelligence, forecasting, and advanced analytics to support business planning, commercial strategy, and long-term portfolio optimization.
 The role will work closely with Commercial Management, Power Analysis, and Gas Supply teams to translate market developments into actionable insights that inform the TC Gas Outlook, identify emerging growth and investment opportunities, and support strategies to maximize asset value.
 What You'll Do 
 Analyze natural gas demand and fuel requirements across the North American power sector, including key drivers of gas-fired generation and regional demand growth.
 Evaluate emerging sources of electricity demand, including data centers and other large loads, and assess their implications for power generation requirements, natural gas demand, and infrastructure opportunities.
 Develop and maintain natural gas demand, supply, and pricing forecasts to support commercial strategy, business planning, and long-term decision-making.
 Evaluate power market fundamentals, including electricity demand growth, generation trends, fuel-switching economics, generation additions and retirements, and regional supply-demand balances.
 Conduct scenario and sensitivity analysis to assess the implications of natural gas prices, power market conditions, generation dispatch, and other market uncertainties on gas demand and asset performance.
 Assess regulatory, environmental, and policy developments and their implications for power generation, natural gas demand, infrastructure requirements, and commercial strategy.
 Develop and maintain analytical models supporting power-sector gas demand forecasting, generation analysis, scenario development, and long-term market outlooks.
 Monitor North American natural gas and power markets to identify emerging trends, risks, and commercial opportunities.
 Translate complex market analysis into clear, actionable insights through dashboards, management reporting, and executive-level presentations.
 Partner with Commercial Management, Power Analysis, Gas Supply, and other internal stakeholders to evaluate market opportunities and support strategic initiatives.
 Identify and implement improvements to analytical processes, data management, and reporting automation to enhance efficiency, consistency, and decision quality.
 Provide data-driven recommendations to leadership by integrating quantitative analysis, market intelligence, and commercial considerations.
 Minimum Qualifications 
 University degree in Economics, Commerce, Business, Finance, Statistics, Engineering, Mathematics, Energy Management, or a related discipline.
 10+ years of progressive experience in energy market analysis, commercial analysis, business strategy, or other relevant analytical roles.
 Strong analytical, quantitative, and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to translate complex market information into actionable business insights.
 Demonstrated experience developing market forecasts, economic and analytical models, and strategic insights using large and complex datasets.
 Strong understanding of North American natural gas and power markets, including power generation economics, fuel requirements, market fundamentals, and the key drivers of natural gas demand.
 Ability to integrate natural gas and power market fundamentals to identify emerging risks, opportunities, and implications for energy infrastructure and commercial strategy.
 Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Power BI, with experience using data analytics and visualization tools to support market analysis and decision-making.
 Strong written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated ability to clearly communicate complex analysis, key implications, and recommendations to leadership and other stakeholders.
 Ability to independently manage multiple priorities, exercise sound judgment, and deliver high-quality analysis in a dynamic and evolving business environment.
 Preferred Qualifications  
 Experience in natural gas, power generation, energy trading, utilities, midstream, or energy infrastructure.
 Knowledge of North American natural gas markets, supply-demand fundamentals, and pipeline systems.
 Understanding of power markets, generation economics, dispatch dynamics, and energy storage technologies.
 Experience performing market forecasting, fundamental analysis, and scenario modeling.
 Knowledge of North American power markets.
 Experience using forecasting models, statistical tools, or energy market analytics platforms.
 Familiarity with business intelligence, automation, and data visualization technologies.

 Job Description: 
 Primary Purpose   
 The Research Ethics Advisor (REA) serves as the primary liaison between the Office of Research Ethics (ORE) and the researcher and his/her research team. The REA is responsible for facilitating the research ethics submission and review process and overseeing the effectiveness and efficiency of the online ethics review system. The REA ensures that the daily operations comply with internal and external requirements. The REA roles support the four research ethics review committees and two advisory committees along with internal and external stakeholders (e.g., researchers, government agencies, accreditation committees/auditors, faculty/department and other administrative staff) regarding the requirements for and outcomes of the ethics review of proposed research. The REA is responsible for developing reports and tracking required information to establish performance metrics for the ORE.   
 Key Accountabilities   
 Facilitate and conduct ethical analysis of research   
 Point persons for all inquiries and questions regarding research compliance obligations including the requirements and processes involved with obtaining and maintaining ethics clearance.   
 Provides consultation to faculty, student and staff researchers regarding the ethics review process and the required ethical obligations according to institutional, national and provincial requirements and guidelines   
 Conducts delegated review of specified minimal risk ethics applications   
 Reviews revisions of designated research ethics applications to ensure the reviewers’ comments have been addressed, meet the required ethical requirements and guidelines, and recommend approval for the research to proceed   
 Reviews amendments/modifications of protocols/ethics applications to assess risk level and recommend approval for the change to be made to the research   
 Promptly and effectively respond to all telephone, mail, and email/web inquiries and questions from faculty, staff, students from any of the six faculties, affiliated Colleges or research institutes, including non-Waterloo researchers or partners regarding research compliance including the ethics review process and administrative requirements   
 Provides advice and assistance about Waterloo’s research ethics process, guidelines, policies and other information as needed by relaying it clearly and accurately   
 Interprets international, federal, provincial, and institutional policies and procedures as it related to Waterloo’s ethics review process and communicate these policies and procedures to researchers, staff, and students   
 Maintains professionalism at all times in conflict situations; use interpersonal skills to handle sensitive and delicate situations and cases (e.g., where research grant support is conditional upon ethics clearance or when an application is time-sensitive or in need of review by multiple offices/levels (e.g., Safety Office)   
 Develops and maintains positive working relationships directly with researchers and ethics committee and advisory committee members to build credibility and encourage proactive discussions and anticipatory analysis of ethical issues in the application undergoing review   
 Makes recommendations to supervisor on ways to clarify ethical research compliance requirements then draft new guidelines or standard operating procedures that interpret these compliance requirements for Waterloo researchers for review by managers   
 Unique to the REA for human research:   
 Establishes, recruits, trains, and monitors the quality, and day to day operations and ethical reviews of the course-based research Delegated Ethics Review Committee according to the terms of reference   
 Unique to the REA for animal research:   
 Oversees the coordination of the post-approval monitoring program in collaboration with the Senior Animal Health Technician – PAM   
 Coordinates Animal Care Committee (ACC) tours and inspections by Consulting Veterinarian, Ontario Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs (OMAFRA) and Canadian Council on Animal Care (CCAC) including the maintenance of records, distribution of reports associated with tours and inspection, and monitors responses and follows through on any required actions   
 Applies procedures for effective monitoring of animal purchases with UWaterloo Purchasing office   
 Utilize Business Tools, Resources and Processes   
 Independently applies standard operating procedures and guidelines to decide on the ethics review route (i.e., either single person delegated, committee delegated or full committee as appropriate) based on several factors and criteria and triages all incoming events (e.g., new applications, annual continuing review, adverse events/incidents, modification, post approval monitoring, protocol deviations, incidental findings)   
 Develops standard operating procedures for back-office operations including the Central Animal Facility and other satellite facilities   
 Reviews applications for completeness and compliance with submission requirements   
 Coordinates the timely review of all research ethics applications through all stages of the ethics clearance process.   
 Verifies that the required ethics training has been completed by Waterloo researchers named on applications and communicate to researchers if this training has not been completed   
 Maintains the integrity of all electronic and paper files and documents including the input of information into ethics system, auditing of records and files, following up with researchers for outstanding or missing information/documents, unapproved submission, and annual progress reports or suspended/lapsed approvals   
 Coordinates the ordering and renewal of key journal subscriptions accreditation/memberships for ORE staff, and maintenance of a library   
 Produces a pre-determined list of ongoing descriptive statistical reports concerning key operational benchmarks   
 Provide Stakeholder Support and Influence   
 Provides day-to-day operational and secretariat support to the research ethics and advisory committees by preparing the agenda and minutes, ordering meals, taking care of room bookings and equipment or IT requests   
 Maintains up to date committee files such as membership lists, reports, terms of reference, minutes, and orientation materials   
 Coordinates and prepares ethics of staff and committee members for site visits from external provincial or federal audit/compliance teams. This includes the advance preparation of audit reports and other supporting documentation, anticipating questions/issues, explaining specific ethics processes, forms, and templates, and following up with requests from auditors for additional information or reports   
 Communicates and troubleshoots with researchers regarding non-compliant or incomplete paperwork   
 Synthesizes required external reports involving external agencies’ operational audits   
 Manages internal and external inspections and national or provincial audit or site-visits   
 Clearly communicates and explains compliance requirements for common international, federal, and provincial regulations and relevant University of Waterloo policies and procedures arising from stakeholders   
 Participates in developing content for ongoing communication initiatives   
 Demonstrate business knowledge   
 Identified sources from which to obtain required information concerning grants, financial obligations, institutional policies   
 Manages special events such as annual meetings   
 Support Ethics Administration System   
 Oversees the maintenance and monitors the functioning of the ethics review system and be the point person with the Office of Research Information Systems Specialist and Computer Systems Specialist by advising   
 Ensures system workflow reflects Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for back office and Committee operations and required use of system/database for users and administrators; notify Senior Manager if gaps identified   
 Establishes, monitors, and updates the system site for all Committees   
 Trains Committee members to use the system site, troubleshoot problems, and prepare instructional materials as needed   
 Maintains a current and complete list of relevant SOPs, policies, and professional development materials are available and accessible for Committee members   
 Monitors and maintains the internal drive for file sharing (R drive) to ensure the structure is efficient and appropriate to meet the needs of the ethics office staff   
 Liaises with Office of Research Operations and Communications staff to identify changes which need to be made on the human and animal websites with respect to development, maintenance, and upgrades   
 Decides on record retention and destruction according to uWaterloo and ORE guidelines   
 Unique to the REA for animal research:   
  Ensures animal purchases do not exceed approved limits   
 Deliver Training and Development   
 Conducts orientation for new committee members   
 Develops materials for workshops or training sessions   
 Leads ethics and integrity compliance training sessions for small to medium sized audiences   
 Assists in the design and development of training content where relevant (e.g., completing an application)   
 Identifies areas where training is needed and proposes ideas to ORE team concerning new training initiatives or needs   
 Assists in analyzing feedback received from training sessions for the purposes of improving future training sessions   
 Unique to the REA for animal research:   
 Develops schedules for training sessions ensuring trainers have been secured for each session in a timely fashion   
 Manages the Desire 2 Learn and MyHRInfo registrations and course content for all animal training.   
 Required Qualifications   
 Education   
 A university degree in a research related field (health sciences or social sciences is preferred) or advanced diploma which involved a research course or project involving human participants or animals OR equivalent extensive ethics administration or research administration and experience at the coordinator level, (5-7 years) OR completion of relevant professional designation in ethics or research administration plus 3-5 years’ experience in ethics administration.   
 Experience   
 3 to 7 years’ experience in ethics administration or research administration.   
 Knowledge/Skills/Abilities   
 Human Research: TCPS2 CORE tutorial CITI Canada – Good Clinical Practice CITI Canada – Social Sciences and Humanities Module Animal Research: AR0001 – Basic Animal Research Theory AR0004, AR0010 CAF Orientation Theory and Tour AR0014 – Advanced Animal Research – Theory; uWaterloo Mandatory Courses: SO1001 – Safety Office Orientation SO1081 – Safety Office Workplace Violence Integrity matters (OHD 120)   
 Basic skills in Microsoft Office suite   
 SharePoint at basic level (SEW 090)   
 Prior use of an online, web-based system   
 Experience in a customer service role (e.g., OHD Inclusivity Certificate)

En tant que Développeur(euse) en IA appliquée III au sein du Laboratoire IA de LGI, vous concevrez et déploierez des composantes d’intelligence artificielle intégrées aux solutions de santé de LGI. Au sein d’une petite équipe multidisciplinaire dédiée à l’IA appliquée, vous travaillerez dans un ou plusieurs des domaines suivants : développement d’applications IA et intégration de modèles, architecture de données et systèmes RAG, et/ou déploiement et opérations IA (LLMOps).
 Il ne s’agit pas d’un poste de recherche fondamentale. Vous explorerez et protyperez des solutions dans un environnement où les approches retenues pourront éventuellement être intégrées aux produits en production, sous réserve d’exigences réelles liées à la conformité, à la performance et à la souveraineté des données. Le rôle est principalement axé sur l’expérimentation et sur la démonstration des possibilités offertes par les technologies d’IA actuelles afin de répondre aux besoins concrets des professionnels de la santé.
 Vos responsabilités 
 Prototypage et développement IA 
 Construire des prototypes, évaluer leur faisabilité technique et itérer rapidement afin de valider des cas d’utilisation IA concrets.
 Développer des fonctionnalités et services propulsés par l’IA et intégrés aux produits LGI, notamment pour l’extraction d’information, la synthèse clinique, l’aide à la décision, la génération de documentation et plus encore.
 Intégrer des LLM et des API de modèles aux flux de travail existants des produits, tout en évaluant et en optimisant les coûts, la qualité et la latence.
 Tester et soutenir le déploiement en production des applications IA développées au sein du Laboratoire IA.
 Données, qualité et architecture RAG 
 Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des pipelines RAG ( Retrieval-Augmented Generation ou génération augmentée par récupération) pour la recherche sémantique et la génération contextualisée à partir de données cliniques et administratives structurées et non structurées.
 Concevoir et maintenir les pipelines d’ingestion, d’indexation et de structuration des données, tout en assurant leur qualité, leur fraîcheur, leur traçabilité et leur gouvernance, conformément aux exigences de la Loi 25 du Québec et de la LPRPDE.
 Développer des composantes de traitement du langage naturel pour l’extraction, l’analyse, la classification et la production de données structurées à partir de textes médicaux et de données de santé.
 Déploiement, opérations et LLMOps 
 Concevoir et maintenir les pipelines de déploiement IA, incluant les processus CI/CD, le versionnement des modèles, la gestion des prompts et les outils nécessaires.
 Surveiller la qualité, la performance et les coûts des modèles; identifier les exigences de fiabilité, de sécurité et de gestion des incidents, y compris les stratégies de retour arrière et d’escalade.
 Établir des métriques d’évaluation pour les pipelines IA, notamment la pertinence, les taux d’hallucination, la latence et la dérive des modèles.
 Maintenir une documentation technique complète des architectures, des décisions de conception et des pratiques opérationnelles.
 Collaboration et partage des connaissances 
 Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de R-D, de Produits et d’Architecture de LGI.
 Participer à la veille technologique en IA et contribuer à la définition des normes, des pratiques exemplaires et des cadres de gouvernance.
 Types de projets au sein du Laboratoire IA 
 Selon les initiatives en cours et votre parcours, vous explorerez différentes approches, développerez des prototypes et évaluerez leur potentiel avant de contribuer à l’incubation et à l’intégration des solutions les plus prometteuses.
 Les projets peuvent notamment inclure : 
 L’ajout de nouvelles capacités aux produits à l’aide de LLM, de modèles spécialisés ou prédictifs, de services d’IA et d’algorithmes d’optimisation.
 La mise à profit de données structurées et non structurées afin de rendre l’information plus accessible et exploitable grâce à l’ingestion, à la recherche sémantique et aux approches fondées sur le RAG.
 L’automatisation de tâches et de processus d’affaires, l’extraction et la transformation de l’information, ainsi que le soutien à la prise de décision.
 L’expérimentation et la comparaison de divers modèles, architectures et approches afin d’en évaluer la qualité, la fiabilité, la latence, les coûts et les implications en matière de sécurité.
 L’évolution de prototypes prometteurs vers des solutions robustes, observables et prêtes à être intégrées aux produits LGI.

 Grande curiosité technique et réel intérêt pour l’IA, l’expérimentation et l’apprentissage continu.
 Autonomie, débrouillardise et capacité à évoluer dans un environnement où les solutions et les processus ne sont pas toujours prédéfinis.
 Polyvalence et capacité à intervenir à plusieurs niveaux de la pile technologique.

We’re looking for a Senior Manager, FP&A & Strategic Finance who understands the analytics behind a business as well as the numbers on the page. Reporting to the VP Finance, you’ll partner with leaders across the business to forecast their spend and headcount, and bring them together into one company-wide financial model. You’ll own budgeting, forecasting and variance analysis end-to-end, and take on strategic finance work that shapes how we invest, from unit economics to scenario planning for leadership decisions. Financial Modelling and Forecasting

 - Run the rolling forecast process and keep it current as the business changes

Budgeting and Performance Management

 - Lead the annual budgeting process and own departmental budgets alongside their leads

 - Deliver monthly variance analysis (budget vs. actuals vs. forecast), explaining what moved and why

 - Build reporting and KPI dashboards that give leadership a clear view of performance

Strategic Finance

 - Analyze unit economics, including customer acquisition cost, lifetime value, contribution margin and payback, to inform growth and investment decisions

 - Build scenario and sensitivity models for major decisions, such as new products, pricing, market expansion and hiring plans

 - Support the founders and leadership with financial analysis for board materials, strategic planning and fundraising as needed

Cross-Functional Partnership

 - Act as the finance business partner to Marketing, Operations, Pharmacy and other teams, translating their plans into financial impact

 - Partner closely with Accounting so actuals, forecasts and reporting stay aligned

 - Explain complex financial analysis clearly to non-finance stakeholders

Process and Scalability

 - Use automation and AI tools to speed up modelling, reporting and analysis

 - Help shape the growth of the FP&A function as the company scales

 - Experience at a smaller, high-growth company where you owned a broad scope of the business, not just one slice of it

 - Expert financial modelling skills, including driver-based models, three-statement models and scenario analysis built from scratch

 - Hands-on experience owning budgeting, forecasting (including expense and headcount) and variance analysis

 - A strong analytical understanding of how a business runs, and the ability to connect operational data to financial outcomes

 - Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, and real enthusiasm for automation and AI tools to improve how finance works

 - Proven ability to partner with and influence department leads and senior leadership

 - Clear written and verbal communication skills, including turning complex analysis into simple recommendations

 - Able to move quickly, work with ambiguity, and adapt as the business scales

Nous recherchons un scientifique de données senior possédant une expertise approfondie dans tous les domaines de l'IA moderne de la modélisation prédictive aux grands modèles linguistiques, en passant par les systèmes d'IA agentique et la vision par ordinateur. Ce poste de contributeur senior exige une grande autonomie, un leadership technique et la capacité de mener à bien des projets complexes en IA avec un minimum de supervision. Le candidat retenu assumera l'entière responsabilité de notre pile d'IA de production existante maintenance, amélioration et mise à l'échelle des modèles et pipelines déjà utilisés par nos clients tout en contribuant au développement de nouvelles capacités. Vous travaillerez à la croisée de la modélisation prédictive, de l'IA générative et des logiciels d'entreprise, avec des travaux déployés à grande échelle sur les données réelles de nos clients. 
 Responsabilités Principales 
 Modélisation prédictive et prévision de la demande 
 Concevoir, développer et optimiser des modèles d'apprentissage automatique pour la prévision de la demande, l'optimisation des stocks et l'analyse des prix.
 Réaliser des analyses exploratoires (EDA), des diagnostics de modèles et des évaluations de la qualité des données.
 Mettre en œuvre des techniques avancées de création de variables (promotions, saisonnalité, jours fériés, ruptures de stock, variables de retard, signaux externes et traitement du signal).
 Concevoir et exécuter des expérimentations, tests d'hypothèses, tests « oracle » et évaluations statistiques.
 Évaluer et comparer différentes approches (LightGBM, Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, PyTorch, DeepAR, ARIMA/SARIMA, Prophet, méthodes d'ensemble, Croston/TSB).
 Gérer le cycle de vie complet des modèles : développement, rétrovalidation, déploiement, surveillance, détection de dérive et réentraînement.
 Grands modèles de langage (LLM) et IA générative 
 Concevoir et développer des solutions basées sur les LLM (RAG, fine-tuning, prompt engineering, sorties structurées, bases de données vectorielles).
 Développer des systèmes d'IA connectés aux données d'entreprise via des API gouvernées.
 Évaluer et intégrer des modèles fondamentaux commerciaux ou open source en production.
 Mettre en place des mécanismes d'explicabilité et de transparence adaptés aux environnements d'entreprise.
 Systèmes d'IA agentique et MCP 
 Concevoir et développer des agents autonomes capables de raisonnement en plusieurs étapes et d'utilisation d'outils.
 Développer des intégrations utilisant le Model Context Protocol (MCP) ou des architectures similaires.
 Mettre en œuvre des processus « human-in-the-loop » (HITL), contrôles d'accès et mécanismes d'approbation.
 Définir des standards de fiabilité, de traçabilité et d'auditabilité pour les systèmes agentiques.
 API et infrastructure IA de production 
 Concevoir des API de lecture sémantique sécurisées reliant les modèles d'IA aux données ERP.
 Développer des pipelines de traitement par lots pour l'inférence et le calcul de variables sur AWS SageMaker et Azure ML.
 Contribuer à l'automatisation CI/CD, aux validations et aux déploiements de modèles.
 Collaborer avec les équipes d'ingénierie des données et MLOps pour industrialiser les modèles (Docker, API, surveillance, inférence à grande échelle).
 Définir des standards pour les pipelines de données, feature stores et versionnement des modèles.
 Collaborer avec les équipes TI et sécurité pour des déploiements conformes et sécurisés.
 Vision par ordinateur 
 Développer et déployer des modèles de vision par ordinateur pour des cas d'usage liés au commerce de détail.
 Intégrer des capacités multimodales aux pipelines IA et aux modèles prédictifs.
 Assurer une veille technologique sur les architectures de vision les plus récentes.
 Gestion des produits IA et amélioration continue 
 Assurer la responsabilité des modèles et pipelines IA en production, de leur stabilité et de leur amélioration continue.
 Contribuer au développement de nouvelles fonctionnalités et capacités IA.
 Identifier et résoudre les enjeux liés à la dette technique, aux performances et à l'évolutivité.
 Agir comme responsable du comportement des modèles IA en production et résoudre rapidement les incidents.
 Documentation et transfert des connaissances 
 Maintenir une documentation complète des modèles, pipelines et expérimentations.
 Assurer la reproductibilité (suivi des expérimentations, contrôle de versions Git, traçabilité des modèles).
 Favoriser le partage des connaissances par des revues de code, présentations techniques et documentation interne.
 Contribuer à la documentation R&D et aux spécifications techniques.
 Leadership technique 
 Définir les approches techniques et livrer des solutions de façon autonome.
 Offrir du mentorat technique et participer aux revues de code et d'architecture.
 Traduire des besoins d'affaires en solutions d'IA robustes et communiquer avec des publics techniques et non techniques.
 Appliquer les principes d'une IA responsable (équité, transparence, gestion des risques).
 Qualifications 
 Formation 
 Doctorat en intelligence artificielle, science des données, informatique ou discipline quantitative connexe fortement privilégié.
 Les personnes candidates détenant une maîtrise et une expérience professionnelle exceptionnelle seront également considérées.
 Expérience 
 Minimum de 5 ans d'expérience en science des données appliquée en industrie (les stages, travaux académiques et postes de recherche ne sont pas comptabilisés).
 Expérience démontrée dans le déploiement et la maintenance de modèles ML en production.
 Expérience dans la gestion de systèmes IA existants et le développement de nouvelles solutions.
 Expérience pratique avec les LLM et l'IA générative (RAG, prompt engineering, sorties structurées, cadres d'évaluation).
 Expérience dans le développement de systèmes d'IA agentique et connaissance du MCP ou de technologies similaires.
 Expérience en développement et déploiement de modèles de vision par ordinateur.
 Capacité démontrée à gérer de façon autonome des initiatives techniques complexes.
 Une expérience en prévision de la demande ou en modélisation de séries temporelles constitue un atout important.
 Une expérience en traitement du signal constitue un atout.
 Une expérience avec les ERP, les modèles de données du commerce de détail ou de la chaîne d'approvisionnement constitue un atout.
 Compétences techniques et comportementales 
 Maîtrise avancée de Python (PyTorch, scikit-learn, LightGBM, XGBoost, TensorFlow/Keras, pandas, polars, NumPy) et des cadres LLM (LangChain, LlamaIndex, SDK Anthropic/OpenAI); R constitue un atout.
 Bibliothèques de prévision (Prophet, DeepAR, ARIMA/SARIMA, Croston/TSB, méthodes d'ensemble).
 Expérience avec Kedro ou outils similaires d'orchestration et traitement par lots à grande échelle.
 Solide expérience MLOps (MLflow, Docker, CI/CD, Git, suivi des expérimentations, registres de modèles, détection de dérive, réentraînement).
 Expérience avec AWS, Azure ML, Azure DevOps et Snowflake/Snowpark.
 Conception et intégration d'API REST (FastAPI, Flask ou équivalent).
 Excellentes bases en statistiques (séries temporelles, inférence bayésienne, causalité, conception expérimentale, tests d'hypothèses).
 Excellente maîtrise de SQL pour l'analyse de données complexes.
 Grande autonomie et capacité à mener des projets techniques de bout en bout.
 Excellentes aptitudes en communication écrite et orale auprès d'auditoires techniques et d'affaires.
 Rigueur analytique et jugement technique solide.
 Esprit collaboratif avec des équipes multidisciplinaires.
 Aisance à évoluer dans des contextes ambigus et à prendre des décisions éclairées.
 I nformations supplémentaires 
 Ce poste est hybride : 2 jours par semaine au bureau à Montréal sont requis.
 Nous remercions tous les candidats de leur intérêt. Toutefois, seuls les candidats sélectionnés pour une entrevue seront contactés.

 Position Summary 
 The Senior Quality Assurance Analyst works closely with product, development, design, infrastructure, and other QA team members to deliver reliable and accessible digital learning products. This role is responsible for testing web applications across the frontend and backend using manual, API, database, automation, accessibility, and performance testing methods.
 The successful candidate will take part in quality activities throughout the software development lifecycle. This includes planning, design reviews, test preparation, testing, defect investigation, release validation, and production regression testing.
 This position will primarily support product development. The QA Manager may also assign a portion of the analyst’s time to infrastructure, platform, performance, or other technical initiatives based on team priorities.
 The regular work schedule is 1:00 PM to 9:00 PM Eastern Time to provide coverage for teams working in the Pacific Time Zone.
Responsibilities 
 Create, maintain, and execute test plans, test scenarios, and test cases for web applications.
 Test frontend and backend functionality, including user interfaces, APIs, databases, integrations, and services.
 Perform functional, regression, smoke, exploratory, integration, usability, and cross browser testing.
 Find, reproduce, investigate, and document defects in Jira with clear steps, evidence, expected results, and actual results.
 Work closely with developers, product managers, designers, infrastructure engineers, and other stakeholders to investigate and resolve quality issues.
 Validate that completed work meets functional requirements, acceptance criteria, design expectations, and quality standards.
 Create, maintain, execute, and improve automated tests using Playwright or similar modern automation tools.
 Help improve the structure, reliability, coverage, and maintainability of the automated regression suite.
 Use AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, Codex, or similar tools to support test development, troubleshooting, documentation, and other QA activities when appropriate.
 Create and maintain clear QA documentation, testing standards, and reusable testing practices.
 Participate in release testing and help identify quality risks before changes are released.
 Stay familiar with the functionality of Nelson products and understand how educators and learners use them in the classroom.
 Infrastructure, Observability and Performance Testing
 The Senior QA Analyst may occasionally support infrastructure and platform testing. The goal is to help the team investigate issues using technical evidence and identify regressions before they reach customers.
 Use telemetry signals such as logs, traces, and metrics to support defect investigation, bug triage, and root cause analysis.
 Review distributed traces to identify suspicious backend calls, service interactions, API requests, or gRPC calls related to a reported issue.
 Use telemetry data to help confirm whether a reported problem is reproducible and to provide useful technical evidence to development and infrastructure teams.
 Create and execute load and performance tests using k6 or similar tools.
 Use load tests as part of regression testing to identify changes in application or service performance.
 Review performance measurements such as response time, throughput, error rate, and percentile latency including p95 latency.
 Compare performance results against previous results or established baselines to identify possible regressions.
 Work with developers and infrastructure engineers to investigate performance issues such as increased latency, excessive service calls, request fanout, or unexpected backend activity.
 Assist with release and production readiness testing when performance or infrastructure validation is required.
 Experience and Qualifications 
 4 or more years of professional experience in software quality assurance or software testing, preferably with web based applications.
 Strong experience testing modern web applications across both frontend and backend systems.
 Hands-on experience testing APIs, databases, integrations, and other backend services.
 Experience creating test plans, test strategies, test scenarios, and detailed test cases.
 Experience designing, writing, and maintaining automated tests. Experience with Playwright is strongly preferred.
 Good understanding of web application architecture, frontend and backend systems, APIs, databases, services, and common security concepts.
 Experience using Jira or a similar issue tracking system to manage defects and testing work.
 Experience working in Agile and Scrum development environments with designers, developers, product managers, and other QA professionals.
 Experience with accessibility testing and knowledge of AODA or related accessibility standards.
 Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills. Able to investigate an issue beyond the visible user interface and provide useful evidence to the team.
 Clear written and verbal communication skills. Able to explain defects and technical findings in simple and concise language.
 Ability to manage multiple priorities and move between product, automation, release, and infrastructure testing when needed.
 Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with cross functional teams.
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Working knowledge of application observability and telemetry, including logs, distributed traces, and metrics.
 Experience using observability tools such as Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry, Application Insights, or similar platforms.
 Experience with performance and load testing using k6 or a similar tool.
 Ability to understand performance measurements such as p95 latency, throughput, response time, and error rate.
 Experience using telemetry and traces to support root cause analysis and defect investigation.
 Experience testing service based or microservice architectures, including REST APIs or gRPC services.
 Experience using AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, Codex, or similar tools as part of software development or QA workflows.
 Experience contributing to automation frameworks, continuous integration workflows, or automated regression pipelines.
 Experience testing education technology, content platforms, learning applications, or other customer facing digital products is an asset.
 What Success Looks Like 
 A successful Senior QA Analyst can independently test complex features, clearly communicate risks, build reliable automated coverage, and help the team investigate issues across the full application stack. The analyst should be comfortable working with both product teams and technical infrastructure teams and should use testing data, automation, and telemetry to make quality decisions based on evidence.

 The Default Management Supervisor is accountable for delivering service excellence, maintaining regulatory and policy compliance, enhancing operational performance, and fostering a highly engaged, customer-focused culture.  Foster an inclusive, collaborative, and accountable team culture that supports engagement, innovation, and continuous improvement.

 Customer Experience & Operational Excellence

 Default Management & Risk Oversight

 Review escalated arrangements, risk mitigation recommendations, and account strategies to ensure appropriate decision-making and escalate to the Manager, Default Management as required.
 Ensure account documentation, customer records, and collection activities meet regulatory, legal, and internal policy requirements.
 Support interactions with legal partners, insolvency proceedings, bankruptcy and consumer proposal activities, and third-party service providers, where applicable.
 Compliance & Governance

 Identify operational, customer, and compliance risks to the Manager, Default Management.

 Change & Strategic Initiatives

 RIC Power Corporation, a Panelmatic Company, is a leading custom manufacturer of medium voltage switchgear, protection, and control systems. We pride ourselves on engineering excellence and delivering high-quality, reliable solutions to our clients across various industries. Join a team dedicated to innovation and quality in a stable and supportive environment.
 Position Summary: 
 We are seeking an experienced Senior Test Technician to join our QC & Testing team. This position is primarily facility-based (approx. 95% in-shop, ~5% on-site/remote field support) and is responsible for independently performing full electrical functional and high-voltage apparatus testing on newly manufactured low and medium voltage switchgear and control systems, in addition to mentoring Test Technicians and supporting the Engineering Quality Lead on Factory Acceptance Testing and test plan development.
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Electrical Functionality Testing: Independently perform full functional testing of protection and control schemes, including control power distribution, protection relay operation, breaker close/open logic, and interlocks.
 HV Apparatus Testing: Independently conduct high-voltage apparatus testing, including Hi-Pot, Partial Discharge (PD), BIL, Heat Run, and Contact Resistance testing.
 Interlock Defeat & Mechanical Safety Verification: Independently perform interlock defeat and mechanical safety verification (door/racking interlocks, TOC/MOC status, etc.) under controlled conditions.
 Visual, Mechanical & Point-to-Point Backup: Perform or back up Visual & BOM confirmation, mechanical functionality confirmation, and Point-to-Point continuity testing as needed.
 Minor Defect Correction: Directly fix connection-integrity issues you personally find during your own testing (e.g., a loose or under-torqued connection that already matches the drawing package), without escalation. Anything that does not match the drawing package is flagged back to Production for rework.
 Electrical Code & Standards: Know and apply relevant electrical codes and standards (CSA, IEEE, UL, etc.) during testing.
 Test Plans & Reports: Contribute technical input into test plan development and final test reports (does not author).
 Troubleshooting: Independently troubleshoot and resolve design- or production-related issues in collaboration with Engineering.
 FAT & Field Support: Lead or back up Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT), and independently provide on-site or remote field support (~5%) when required.
 Mentorship & Production Feedback: Provide informal, on-the-floor guidance to Test Technicians during testing, and, alongside the Engineering Quality Lead, feed findings back to the Production team for learning and improvement.
 Safety Practice: Work independently and safely, including on energized work; identify and contribute hazards to Job Hazard Analyses (JHA). Stop-work authority applies regardless of tier: halt any test you believe is unsafe.
 ISO/QMS Contribution: Contribute to ISO/QMS process improvement.
 Equipment & Supplier Inspection: Verify your own test equipment is current before use, and back up Supplier & incoming-inspection quality checks as needed.
 Required Qualifications: 
 Education & Experience: Diploma or Degree in Electrical Engineering, with 3+ years of experience in low and medium voltage switchgear and power apparatus testing.
 Technical Expertise: Expert at interpreting complex electrical drawings and performing hands-on testing.
 Safety: Demonstrated ability to work independently and safely on energized/high-voltage tasks.
 Soft Skills: Strong troubleshooting abilities, high attention to detail, and proficiency in MS Office for technical reporting.
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 FAT Experience: Experience with Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) procedures.
 Standards Knowledge: Working knowledge of relevant industry standards (e.g., CSA, IEEE, ANSI, NETA, UL).
 Network Testing: Familiarity with communication network testing.

Sadie is building voice AI for hotels. When a guest calls, Sadie answers, day or night: it shares property information, quotes availability and rates, and books reservations in the hotel's own systems.
 We're looking for an early-career AI engineer to join our Montreal team and ship product work from your first weeks. The team is lean, so your code reaches real hotels quickly, and you'll be trusted with more as you prove yourself. Use AI to research, draft, test, and automate. You're responsible for the quality of the result.
 What you'll do
 Improve how the voice agent handles real calls 
 You'll review calls and transcripts to find where Sadie gets a request wrong, write the fix, and test it before it reaches a hotel. When Sadie fumbles a booking, the hotel hears about it from their guest.
 Build hotel system integrations 
 You'll build and maintain the connections that let Sadie check real availability and rates and write reservations back to the hotel. A mistake here means a double booking or a guest quoted the wrong price.
 Ship features and measure quality 
 You'll take features from idea to production and help build the test calls and checks that tell us whether a release made Sadie better or worse. Expect close code review, and to review others' code as you grow.
 What you'll bring
 You're graduating now, or graduated in the last one to two years.
 Either a FAANG internship, or startup experience or a project you built and shipped yourself.
 Clear evidence of initiative and strong ambition.
 Solid programming fundamentals and comfort building with LLMs and APIs.
 You work independently, ask for help early, and finish what you start.
 Useful experience
 A degree from a top Canadian university
 Hackathons, standout projects, or strong internships
 Voice or conversational AI work
 Who will enjoy this role
 Someone who hears a call that went wrong and can't let it go until it's fixed. The hard part: the team is small and moves quickly, so there's less hand-holding than at a large company, and your mistakes reach real guests.
 Why this role matters
 Small hotel teams miss calls, and each missed call can be a lost booking. As more hotels rely on Sadie, we need engineers who can own parts of the product. You'll start with well-defined pieces, and your scope will grow as fast as you do.

Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.



If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.



Our Infrastructure Services organization is responsible for the underlying infrastructure that powers the 1Password application. It includes Compute Services, Network and Edge Services, and Stateful Services.



As a Senior Staff Cloud Platform Engineer, you set the multi-year technical strategy for Infrastructure Services. You decide where the organization invests, define the architecture and standards that every infrastructure team and internal tenant builds on, and make sure our compute, network and edge, and stateful platforms evolve as one coherent system rather than three separate ones. You partner with engineering and product leadership, security, and finance to balance reliability, security, cost, and delivery speed, and you are the senior technical voice for infrastructure across the company.



This is a hands-on role. You write design docs, prototype, review the hardest designs, and step into the most serious incidents. But your main impact comes from making many teams more effective and from the decisions that hold up for years.



How we’re using AI today

Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers.



This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.



What we're looking for:

 - You have set technical direction across multiple teams. You have owned an infrastructure strategy or architecture spanning several teams or an entire organization, and you can point to the multi-year outcomes: what others adopted, what shipped, and what measurably improved.

 - You have operated Kubernetes at production scale. This includes multi-cluster, multi-tenant, customer-traffic-bearing environments (EKS or similar managed platforms preferred). You know it deeply, from autoscaling and admission control to GitOps, workload identity, and fleet-wide cluster upgrades.

 - You combine depth with breadth. Beyond Kubernetes, you have working fluency in networking and edge and in stateful data systems, and you understand how a decision in one layer affects the rest.

 - You have made reliability a standard, not a project. You defined SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets, and you got multiple teams to adopt them. You have improved incident response, post-incident learning, and disaster recovery across an organization, not just on your own team.

 - You have cut cloud costs through engineering. You can show measurable, real-dollar impact from work such as capacity automation, right-sizing, architecture changes, or commitment strategy, and you have worked with finance on forecasting and tradeoffs.

 - You build security in by design. You have driven practices such as workload identity, least-privilege IAM and RBAC, credential rotation, and strong isolation in multi-tenant environments, and you have partnered with security teams on risk decisions and compliance requirements.

 - You still build. You are proficient in Go (or a similar language) and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), and you have a track record of automating complex, high-toil operational workflows at fleet scale.

 - You influence without relying on authority. You write clear strategy and design documents, present to senior leaders, resolve technical disagreements between teams, and build alignment on difficult tradeoffs.

 - You grow other engineers. You have mentored Senior and Staff engineers, raised the bar on design review, and helped shape how your organization hires and evaluates technical talent.

 - Hands-on experience with service mesh and service-to-service networking, such as Linkerd or Amazon VPC Lattice.

 - Designing developer platform abstractions for internal teams, such as paved-road service toolkits and production readiness frameworks, that measurably improved usability and productivity.

 - Helping build AI-assisted operations tools, such as auto-remediation or AI-assisted diagnosis, rather than only using them.

 - Operating highly available, multi-region services in a large SaaS environment, including capacity planning and performance optimization at scale.

What you can expect:

 - Set the multi-year technical strategy and architecture for Infrastructure Services, working with directors and senior engineering leadership to shape roadmap and investment decisions, including build versus buy.

 - Define the patterns, standards, and guardrails across compute, network and edge, and stateful services that internal teams depend on for years.

 - Serve as an escalation point for major incidents, and drive organization-wide improvements to incident management, reliability targets, and disaster recovery.

 - Lead cost, capacity, and efficiency strategy for our cloud footprint, with measurable goals.

 - Drive adoption of automation and AI-assisted operations to reduce toil across the organization.

 - Mentor Staff and Senior engineers, raise the bar on design review and engineering practice, and help us hire and develop the next generation of infrastructure leaders.

 Poste: Gestionnaire, relations stratégiques avec les pharmacies, Québec
 Relève de :  Directrice exécutive, Unité d’affaires Médecine Générale
 Lieu: Poste sur le terrain au Québec
 Ce que vous ferez
 Allons-y. Changeons le monde. 
 Le ou la gestionnaire, relations stratégiques avec les pharmacies, Québec, est responsable d’établir et de gérer des relations stratégiques avec les parties prenantes du secteur pharmaceutique au Québec ainsi qu’avec les canaux émergents d’engagement des patients soutenus par les pharmacies, afin de faire progresser l’accès des patients, l’engagement des pharmaciens et les priorités d’affaires de l’Unité d’affaires Médecine générale (GMBU), avec un accent principal sur les domaines cardiovasculaire et cardiométabolique.
 Responsabilités clés
 1. Stratégie pharmaceutique au Québec et planification des comptes
 Élaborer et mettre en œuvre des stratégies d’engagement propres au Québec, alignées sur les priorités de la GMBU dans les canaux de pharmacies communautaires, spécialisées et numériques.
 Responsabilités : 
 Élaborer et maintenir des plans de comptes stratégiques pour les organisations pharmaceutiques prioritaires, les bannières/chaînes, les associations, les partenaires en pharmacie spécialisée et les canaux numériques d’engagement des patients.
 Bâtir et entretenir un réseau de parties prenantes et de décideurs clés du secteur pharmaceutique partout au Québec.
 Repérer des occasions d’améliorer l’éducation des patients, l’accès, l’amorce du traitement, l’observance, la persistance au traitement et le soutien aux patients.
 Produire des perspectives de marché sur la pratique en pharmacie, les parcours des patients, le remboursement, l’activité concurrentielle et les modèles de soins émergents.
 Transformer les perspectives pharmaceutiques et de marché en recommandations concrètes pour les partenaires interfonctionnels.
 2. Gestion des relations avec les parties prenantes
 Agir comme personne-ressource principale pour les comptes pharmaceutiques clés, les organisations et les partenaires numériques du secteur pharmaceutique.
 Collaborer avec les propriétaires de pharmacies, les pharmaciens, les leaders de bannières, les partenaires en pharmacie spécialisée, les associations et les intervenants en soins virtuels de manière conforme et axée sur la valeur.
 Représenter Amgen lors de rencontres avec les clients, de conférences et de forums sectoriels pertinents.
 Faciliter la collaboration entre les parties prenantes externes et les équipes internes interfonctionnelles.
 3. Création de valeur et initiatives axées sur le patient
 Cerner et co-créer des initiatives fondées sur la pharmacie qui soutiennent l’éducation des patients, l’accès, l’observance et le soutien aux patients dans les domaines cardiovasculaire et cardiométabolique.
 Collaborer avec les équipes internes afin de développer des ressources, outils et modèles de service conformes.
 Soutenir la mise en œuvre de programmes de soutien aux patients dans les pharmacies et d’autres canaux d’engagement approuvés.
 Évaluer les résultats des initiatives et tirer parti des apprentissages pour améliorer les programmes à venir.
 4. Expertise du marché et du secteur pharmaceutique au Québec
 Surveiller la pratique en pharmacie, le remboursement, les modèles de soutien aux patients, la santé numérique, les politiques et l’évolution législative ayant une incidence sur le marché québécois.
 Maintenir une connaissance à jour des exigences de la RAMQ, de l’INESSS et de l’Ordre des pharmaciens du Québec (OPQ), ainsi que de l’évolution du champ d’exercice de la pharmacie.
 Évaluer les nouveaux modèles d’engagement pharmaceutique et des patients et leurs répercussions sur l’accès des patients et la stratégie commerciale.
 Informer les parties prenantes internes des tendances du marché, des besoins des clients et des occasions stratégiques.
 Collaborer avec la personne responsable de la pharmacie à l’échelle nationale afin d’harmoniser les priorités du Québec avec la stratégie pharmaceutique nationale.
 5. Leadership interfonctionnel
 Agir comme expert ou experte en matière de pharmacie au Québec pour la GMBU.
 Collaborer avec les équipes de l’accès au marché, des affaires médicales, des services aux patients, des ventes, du marketing, des affaires juridiques, de la conformité, des affaires réglementaires, des affaires gouvernementales et d’autres fonctions clés.
 Coordonner la planification, l’établissement des priorités, l’alignement des ressources, la gestion des risques et l’exécution des initiatives liées à la pharmacie.
 Cerner les risques et les obstacles opérationnels, puis recommander des solutions pratiques.
 6. Influence stratégique et réalisation de la performance
 Diriger des discussions stratégiques avec les clients des pharmacies, les partenaires en pharmacie spécialisée et les organisations d’engagement des patients.
 Comprendre les priorités des parties prenantes et élaborer des solutions mutuellement avantageuses et conformes.
 Mener des échanges complexes tout en maintenant de solides relations à long terme.
 Atteindre les objectifs de comptes, les résultats d’engagement des parties prenantes et les initiatives stratégiques convenus.

 Qualifications requises
 Le bilinguisme (français et anglais) est requis. La personne titulaire du poste doit être en mesure de communiquer efficacement en anglais, puisque ses fonctions comportent des interactions régulières avec des collègues et des partenaires situés à l’extérieur du Québec.
 Baccalauréat en sciences de la vie, en administration des affaires, en politiques de santé, en administration des soins de santé ou dans un domaine connexe.
 Expérience pertinente dans les secteurs pharmaceutique, biotechnologique, pharmaceutique, de l’accès au marché, des services aux patients, de la santé numérique, des soins virtuels, des soins de santé ou de la gestion de comptes.
 Bonne compréhension de l’écosystème de santé et de la pharmacie au Québec, y compris les parcours de soins cardiovasculaires et/ou cardiométaboliques, les parcours patients et les considérations liées à l’accès.

 Expérience dans l’élaboration de plans de comptes, de stratégies d’engagement des parties prenantes et de perspectives clients à l’appui des objectifs d’affaires.

 Capacité à diriger des initiatives interfonctionnelles sans autorité directe et à évoluer dans un environnement dynamique et hautement réglementé.
 Excellentes aptitudes en communication écrite et orale en français et en anglais, avec capacité d’interagir avec la clientèle québécoise en français et de collaborer à l’échelle nationale.

 Permis d’exercice de la pharmacie au Québec considéré comme un atout.

 Expérience à l’appui d’initiatives propres au Québec au sein d’une organisation pharmaceutique nationale.

 Orientation vers les résultats : Favorise l’exécution, gère les discussions complexes avec les parties prenantes et obtient des résultats d’affaires mesurables.
 Leadership interfonctionnel : Influence et coordonne des équipes multidisciplinaires afin de livrer des solutions conformes et axées sur la clientèle.

ABOUT BASETEN

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products.



THE ROLE

We're looking for distributed systems engineers and product-minded generalists to build the distributed runtime that powers large-scale LLM inference on Baseten. Our inference platform empowers customers to deploy and operate cutting-edge models with industry-leading performance, scalability, and reliability. It also powers Model APIs, our hosted endpoints for the latest open-source models. You'll work across the stack, from the developer experience customers use to deploy models, through the libraries behind features like tool calling and reasoning, down to the systems that orchestrate deployments on Kubernetes and route traffic efficiently. Your job is to make sure every model on our platform is fast, reliable, and cost-efficient. You'll join a small, high-impact team at the intersection of distributed systems, model performance, infrastructure, and product, helping define how developers use AI models at scale. This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy owning systems in production, solving hard integration problems, and making complex infrastructure simple and reliable for users.

 

EXAMPLE INITIATIVES

You'll get to work on these types of projects on our Inference Platform:

 - The Baseten Inference Stack at NVIDIA Dynamo Day https://www.baseten.co/blog/nvidia-dynamo-day-baseten-inference-stack/

 - 2x faster inference with KV cache-aware routing https://www.baseten.co/blog/how-baseten-achieved-2x-faster-inference-with-nvidia-dynamo/

 - How Baseten multi-cloud capacity management (MCM) unifies deployments https://www.baseten.co/blog/how-baseten-multi-cloud-capacity-management-mcm-powers-cloud-self-hosted-and-hybr/#comparing-deployment-options-cloud-vs-self-hosted-vs-hybrid


RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Build the infrastructure and orchestration systems that deploy and run large-scale distributed LLM inference, including routing, autoscaling, scheduling, and runtime management.

 - Design, build, and operate Model APIs, with a focus on advanced inference capabilities: structured outputs (JSON mode, grammar-constrained generation), tool/function calling, and multimodal serving.

 - Implement platform fundamentals such as API versioning, validation, usage metering, quotas, and authentication.

 - Instrument deep observability (metrics, traces, logs) and build repeatable benchmarks for speed, reliability, and quality. Help set best practices for testing, release automation, and operational excellence.

 - Debug and harden complex production systems spanning Kubernetes, distributed runtimes, networking, and GPU workloads to improve reliability and scalability.

 - Partner with Inference Performance engineers and other teams to make new optimizations broadly available to customers and easy to configure.

 - Own projects end to end, from architecture through deployment, monitoring, and iteration on customer feedback. Along the way, make thoughtful tradeoffs between performance, reliability, operational simplicity, and developer experience.

 

REQUIREMENTS

 - Bachelor's, Master's, or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

 - 3+ years building and operating distributed systems, backend infrastructure, or large-scale APIs where reliability, latency, and scale are first-class concerns.

 - A proven track record of owning low-latency, reliable backend services, including rate limiting, auth, quotas, metering, and migrations.

 - Infrastructure instincts with a feel for performance: profiling, tracing, capacity planning, and SLO management.

 - Comfort debugging performance and reliability issues across multiple layers of the stack, from application behavior down to runtime and infrastructure internals.

 - A strong sense of developer experience. You think about how systems are used, not just how they work.

 - Eagerness to learn new languages, frameworks, and systems, and a real interest in inference engineering. Prior ML or LLM experience isn't required, though experience with model serving or inference systems is a plus.

 - Excellent written communication and collaboration skills, including writing clear design docs and working across functions.

 

NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with or contributions to LLM inference engines and frameworks such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, TGI, or Dynamo.

 - Deep Kubernetes experience, including operators and custom resources, plus familiarity with service meshes or API gateways.

 - Experience with distributed scheduling, autoscaling, or service orchestration.

 - Experience operating GPU workloads in production.

 - A background in developer-facing infrastructure or APIs, or contributions to open-source infrastructure or ML systems.

 - Familiarity with observability tooling, CI/CD systems, or release automation.



BENEFITS

 - Competitive compensation, including meaningful equity

 - (U.S. only) 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance for employee and dependents

 - Flexible PTO policy including company wide Winter Break (our offices are closed from Christmas Eve to New Year's Day!)

 - Paid parental leave

 - Fertility and family-building stipend through Carrot

 - (U.S. only) Company-facilitated 401(k)

 - Exposure to a variety of ML startups, offering unparalleled learning and networking opportunities.
